newsitem.title: UK: UK TV channel sanctioned over incest scene.
newsitem.headline: UK TV channel sanctioned over incest scene.

text.p: Britain's commercial television regulator said on Tuesday it had ordered Channel 4 to broadcast an apology for a scene in a soap opera about incest between a brother and sister.

The Independent Television Commission (ITC) said it had ordered the sanction over a scene in "Brookside" on August 3 when siblings Nat and Georgia Simpson were shown cuddling in bed after sexual intercourse.

"The Independent Television Commission has directed Channel 4 to broadcast an apology for the Brookside omnibus on Saturday 3 August at 5:05 pm which the ITC concluded contained unacceptable scenes relating to a storyline about incest between a brother and sister," it said.
The ITC said the scene on Channel 4, one of Britain's two commercial television channels, was inappropriate for early evening and in breach of the ITC's family viewing rules.
It said Channel 4 was required to broadcast an apology "in terms to be agreed with the ITC" immediately before Brookside was shown on November 2.
